label: Knowledge modeling
definition: Designing explicit representations of concepts, entities and relationships.
negative: Generic data entry or a job title alone is insufficient.

label: Ontology engineering
definition: Designing, implementing, aligning, validating or maintaining formal ontologies.
negative: The word ontology in a reading list does not establish this activity.

label: Taxonomy management
definition: The ongoing governance of a controlled vocabulary or classification scheme, including term creation, deprecation, and mapping.
negative: Using a taxonomy does not establish responsibility for managing it.

label: Knowledge graph construction
definition: Building or populating a knowledge graph as a dataset from source information.
negative: Mentioning a graph database or an agent memory alone is insufficient.

label: Semantic integration
definition: The task of reconciling data from heterogeneous sources into a shared semantic model.
negative: Generic ETL without semantic reconciliation is insufficient.

label: Entity resolution
definition: The task of determining when different data records refer to the same real-world entity.
negative: Named entity recognition alone does not establish resolution.

label: RDF data mapping
definition: Converting or virtualizing non-RDF source data into RDF using explicit mappings.
negative: A bare R2RML mention is only a candidate; confirm mapping work or capability.

label: Information retrieval
definition: Finding information relevant to a query or information need.
negative: Retrieving an API response alone is insufficient.

label: Semantic search
definition: Finding information using meaning, semantic representations or relationships beyond literal keyword matching.
negative: A search box or SPARQL support alone is insufficient.

label: Retrieval-augmented generation
definition: Grounding generated responses in information retrieved from an external corpus.
negative: RAG must refer to generation, not a status colour or unrelated acronym.

label: GraphRAG
definition: Using graph structure or graph-derived context in retrieval-augmented generation.
negative: Knowledge graph and LLM co-occurrence alone is insufficient; distinguish a named software implementation.

label: AI agent memory and context
definition: Maintaining or supplying persistent knowledge and context used by AI agents.
negative: Generic agent development does not imply persistent memory.

label: Graph analytics
definition: Analyzing graph structure using graph algorithms, network measures or graph-based analytical methods.
negative: A chart or graph database alone does not establish analytics.

label: Graph reasoning
definition: Deriving new facts from a graph using logical inference over its ontology, such as OWL entailments.
negative: LLM chain-of-thought or generic analytical reasoning does not imply logical graph inference.

label: Data governance
definition: Defining and maintaining policies, accountability and controls for data assets and their use.
negative: Corporate governance or generic compliance boilerplate is insufficient.

label: Provenance and lineage
definition: Recording or tracing the origins, transformations and derivation of data or assertions.
negative: A job source URL is ingestion provenance, not evidence that the role performs lineage work.

label: Data validation
definition: Checking data against explicit structural, semantic or quality constraints.
negative: Mentioning SHACL alone requires contextual confirmation of validation work or capability.

label: Graph visualization
definition: Visually representing or interactively exploring graph entities and relationships.
negative: Generic dashboard development is insufficient.

label: Fraud detection
definition: Identifying or investigating fraudulent transactions, entities or behavior.
negative: Do not assign from a bank employer or application-security boilerplate.

label: Recommendation systems
definition: Selecting or ranking items, content or actions for a recipient using modeled relevance.
negative: Making recommendations to colleagues is insufficient.

label: Drug discovery
definition: Finding and evaluating candidate therapeutic compounds or biological targets.
negative: A pharmaceutical employer alone does not establish this use case.

label: Environment & Agriculture
definition: Resources for the environment, climate, ecology, natural resources, agriculture, forestry, food production, or fisheries.
negative: Use when environmental systems, conservation, land and water management, farming, crops, livestock, or food production are primary.

label: Finance & Business
definition: Resources for finance, accounting, markets, commerce, enterprise operations, industry, or business transactions.
negative: Use for financial instruments and institutions, corporate information, products and services, supply chains, and commercial processes.

label: General / Cross-domain
definition: Foundational, upper-level, broadly reusable, or genuinely multi-domain resources without one dominant subject domain.
negative: Assign only with evidence of cross-domain scope. Missing or inconclusive domain evidence stays unassigned; replace the existing fallback instruction.

label: Geospatial
definition: Resources centered on geographic location, spatial relationships, mapping, geodesy, or Earth observation.
negative: Use for GIS, cartography, cadastral data, place identifiers, coordinate systems, and explicitly spatial datasets. Do not use solely because a domain can contain locations.

label: Government & Public Sector
definition: Resources for government, law, public administration, public services, civic institutions, or defense.
negative: Use when national, regional, or local public-sector operations and legal or civic information are primary. Prefer International Development for aid, humanitarian, and cross-country development programs.

label: International Development
definition: Resources for international aid, humanitarian action, sustainable development, and cross-country social or economic development.
negative: Use for development programs, global development indicators, humanitarian response, and aid organizations. Prefer Government & Public Sector for domestic administration and public services.

label: Library & Cultural Heritage
definition: Resources for libraries, archives, museums, bibliography, language, the arts, history, or cultural heritage collections.
negative: Use for cataloging and authority data, archival description, museum collections, historical and artistic subjects, linguistic vocabularies, and cultural memory.

label: Life Sciences & Healthcare
definition: Resources whose principal subject is biology, medicine, health, clinical care, biomedical research, or pharmaceuticals.
negative: Use for biological and biomedical subject matter, anatomy, disease, clinical practice, health services, and related life-science data. Prefer Environment & Agriculture when environmental or farming concerns are primary.

label: Technology & Web
definition: Resources whose principal subject is computing, data technology, telecommunications, the internet, or web standards.
negative: Use for domain-specific computing and web concepts. Prefer General / Cross-domain for foundational semantic models designed to apply across subject domains.

label: Healthcare
